profile.scope: Actual selfhost image provides its own parse/expand/check. No canonical-checker substitution, host AST-tag adaptation, or target-code instrumentation.

screen.scope: One serial unprofiled control/candidate checker pair using actual selfhost images, identical accepted parser/expander, frozen full compiler corpus, driver and runtime. Candidate image must come through actual native or emitted selfhost compilation, never patched output.
screen.rejectIf: Candidate checker elapsed time, guardian peak RSS or guardian peak footprint exceeds control by more than 5%, or semantic/source/ownership check fails.
screen.passMeaning: Permits full qualification only; not performance or compiler acceptance.

qualification.required: Fresh full native validation with zero exclusions/output patches, native-stage0 to stage1 to stage2 byte equality, all existing consumers if still viable.
qualification.performanceAcceptedOnlyIf: Both native and JS pipeline arithmetic mean and median improve in twelve retained original unprofiled serial interleaved samples; median peak RSS and footprint must not increase.
qualification.failureAction: Use --fail-fast-performance=true; stop remaining qualification/consumer work at mandatory failure. Commit rejected source/frozen inputs/evidence before restoring R12.

scope: Unmodified accepted R12 actual selfhost image supplies its own parser, expander and checker. Bounded CPU/allocation windows on the full frozen root, without host constructor adaptation. Profiling is not timing acceptance.

commands.environment: env HEAVY_GATE_MEMORY_MIB=8192 HEAVY_GATE_RSS_MIB=8192 HEAVY_GATE_POLL_MS=10 HEAVY_GATE_TIMEOUT_MS=600000 BUN_JSC_forceRAMSize=4294967296

limitations: Final source tape only; no transient peak-capacity claim.
64-KiB hash scratch is allocated only after the measured check phase.
CPU/allocation sampling enabled only inside the declared step windows; no heap snapshot.
Step windows cover identical public checker calls, not whole-pipeline throughput.
CPU timeDeltas are sample weights, not exact function time; profiler overhead is included.
Allocation selfSize values are statistical estimates including collected objects, not exact allocation or retained bytes.
Exclusive categories do not identify every optimized/inlined operation; use function/source locations as evidence.
Profiled wall time cannot accept or reject a speed optimization.

candidate.mechanism: Isolate scheduler fuel-threaded progress/stack transport; remove per-transition intermediate RunState, not G26 arena/name/descriptor/publication changes.
candidate.historicalStatus: G26 combined package rejected; standalone scheduler has not been qualified.
